instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Register this device to receive or read my notices", and give it route; address.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:register-my-notification-device and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Pass route (web-push, apns, apns-activity or live) and the address its app received.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: notification-device (records:read, records:list, records:write).
